# 5 Top E-Wallets in the Philippines and What They’re Best For (2026)
## A Snapshot of the Top E-Wallets in the Philippines
### **GCash**
It now offers everything from mobile load and bill payments to investment products and microloans.

GCash users can access GSave (a savings account), GCredit (a microloan feature), and GInvest (which lets users invest in mutual funds).

These features are all part of GCash’s mission to make formal financial services accessible to every Filipino, regardless of income or location.
